svg.title: The services share of employment overtook agriculture and the gap widened
svg.desc: Dot chart: The services share of employment overtook agriculture and the gap widened: Services: 35.4% in 1991, 38.0% in 1995, 39.3% in 2000, 42.3% in 2005, 44.6% in 2010, 48.1% in 2015, 49.5% in 2020, 50.6% in 2025; Agriculture: 42.8% in 1991, 40.6% in 1995, 39.4% in 2000, 36.3% in 2005, 32.6% in 2010, 28.5% in 2015, 27.2% in 2020, 25.8% in 2025.
